title: True: Trepidation
description: A semi-medieval horror modpack with custom textures, spooky mods and a questline available to give you direction for where to go in your world!
body:
>   # _**A Chill Crawls Down Your Spine...**_ 
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c391266f80421f05b89c5d0b3a4172cde2e9eca2_0.webp)
## **_Newspaper_** ##
True: Trepidation is the successor modpack for [True: Scopophobia](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/true-scopophobia), with less surrounding [Calvin](https://www.youtube.com/@Calvin9000)'s original modpack for his From the Fog series and instead moves into its own story for you to uncover. This is a semi-medieval horror project that adds abandoned structures, spooky effects, unspoken entities from the dark and several other mods to help introduce a paranoic feel to your world.

## _The Unknown_ ##


<details>
<summary>Warning!</summary>
This project may contain themes of horror such as violence, gore, and jumpscares. Please play this modpack with caution.


</details>
